title:
Transform used in `Reliability.ModelSetupJobsDataPrepDefinitionList`, `Reliability.ModelSetupJobsModelConfigDefinitionList`,
and `Reliability.ModelSetupJobsSensorCorrelationDefinitionList`.
This transform calculates the number of [jobs](JobBase) with status equal to {@link JobStatusEnum#completed} and {@link JobStatusEnum#failed},
and {@link ModelConfigRun} with status equal to {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.RunStatus#COMPLETE} and {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.RunStatus#FAILED}.
name: JobAndModelConfigRunStatusCountTransform
